top_signals.title: Kalshi loses appeal over Ohio and Tennessee sports betting laws, widening circuit split
top_signals.summary: A federal appeals court ruled on Friday that Kalshi has not adequately shown its sports event contracts are swaps under the Commodity Exchange Act.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Trump says he approved new fuel economy standards, rolling back Biden-era rules
top_signals.summary: The new fuel economy standards will reverse the Biden administration's stricter policies meant to spur electric vehicle adoption.

top_signals.title: SEC Commissioner Hester Peirce to leave post on Oct. 2
top_signals.summary: Peirce, known as “Crypto Mom,” served on the SEC for about eight years, including as director of the Crypto Task Force.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
